name: vecinopay
description: VecinoPay: reemplazo digital del cuaderno del fiado (FIE 7651, ciclo 2026-20)

scripts.build: npm run build:finance && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:finance && npm run start:dev -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/finance && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.start:api: npm run build:finance && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run start -w apps/api
scripts.start:web: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run preview -w apps/web
